params.body:
## Why

Three complaints from Shane's phone, and they turned out to share one cause: every screen
carried its own answer for the air above its title, and nothing decided it centrally.

Measured on this branch's parent, from the bottom of the black top bar to the top of the page
title:

| screen | 390 | 1280 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Stocklist | 3px | 10px |
| Eigen wagenpark | 25px | 32px |
| Relaties | 27px | 6px |
| Dealers | 61px | 28px |
| Offertes | 27px | 6px |
| Biedingsaanbod | 27px | 6px |
| Mijn aangeboden wagens | 27px | 6px |
| Instellingen | 47px | 54px |
| Mijn werklijsten | 25px | 32px |
| Wagendetail | 11px | 31px |

After: **20px on every one of them, at 390 and at 1280** (24 measurements, one value).

## Inventory

Every page head in the app, what it was, what it became.

| Screen (file) | Before | After |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Stocklist (`livewire/stocklist-browser.blade.php`) | `.ui-header-sticky` inside `.ui-browser`, which added its own 10px above the head | head reads `--ui-head-top`; `.ui-browser` with a head of its own keeps no padding |
| Wagendetail (`stocklist/header.blade.php`) | own `ui-detail-header` flex row, `mt-5 mt-md-0`, `margin-top: 12px !important` on phones; "Aanpassen" a separate block below the head | `ui-page-head` / `ui-page-title` / `ui-page-actions`, one actions row |
| Eigen wagenpark (`livewire/own-stock-list.blade.php`) | `row page-titles ui-list-header … mt-5 mt-md-0` + `margin-top: 12px !important` | `row page-titles ui-list-header …`, top margin from the token |
| Wagenformulier (`ownstock/header.blade.php`, `ownstock/vehicle_form_preview.blade.php`) | `row page-titles ui-form-header … mt-5 mt-md-0` + `margin-top: 10px !important` | idem |
| Relaties (`relation/header.blade.php`) | `ui-page-head`, `margin: 28px 0 14px` on phones | unchanged markup; `margin-top` from the token |
| Dealers/gebruikers (`settings/dealer/header.blade.php`, `settings/user/header.blade.php`) | `row page-titles mt-5 mt-md-0` / `ui-page-head` | idem |
| Instellingen (`settings/setting/header.blade.php`) | `<section class="mt-5 md:mt-0 mb-4 ui-settings-title">` with Tailwind type classes | `<section class="ui-page-head ui-settings-title">` with `ui-page-title` and `ui-page-actions` |
| Toegang (`settings/access/header.blade.php`) | bare `<h1 class="page-header">` from the theme | `ui-page-head` / `ui-page-title` |
| Offertes, bestelbonnen, huurcontracten (`offertes/header.blade.php`, `offertes/headerContracts.blade.php`) | `ui-page-head` | unchanged markup; token |
| Export, lopende/gewonnen export, biedingsaanbod (`export/header.blade.php`, `export/ongoing_won/header.blade.php`, `export/bidding_offers/header.blade.php`) | `ui-page-head` | unchanged markup; token |
| Werklijsten (`worklist/index.blade.php`) | `ui-worklist-header` inside `.ui-page` with `padding-top: 26px` | token on the head, no padding on `.ui-page` |
| Rollen, releasenotes, transport, opties, extra opties, locaties, vereisten, nuttige links, simple, merchants, documentatie | `row page-titles mt-5 mt-md-0` | `row page-titles`, token |

Two smaller alignment fixes were needed to make the number exact rather than nearly exact:
the title column of a Bootstrap-grid head was centred against the taller actions column (it
started 4px lower), and `.ui-page-title` was centred against a taller actions block for the
same reason. Both now start at the top of their row; the actions stay centred.

## What each became

**1. One distance.** `--ui-head-top` (20px) plus `--ui-head-slack`, which corrects for the
theme's fixed wrapper: its padding stops 1px above the bar on a phone and 6px past it on a
desktop, and without that correction the two breakpoints land on 19 and 26 instead of on the
same number. One selector list applies it to every head root. A screen that wants different
air is a screen that is wrong: change the token, not the screen.

**2. The vehicle type on Stocklist.** Two shapes for one choice, and the data decides which:
up to and including three types it is a segmented control (one row, equal segments, the full
width of its column, capped at 520px on a desktop, the active segment filled); above that a
select labelled "Soort voertuig". The threshold is `StocklistBrowser::SEGMENTED_MAX_GROUPS`
and lives nowhere else. Both shapes call the same `setGroup`, so the filter and paging reset
and the active type on load are exactly as they were. `/own-vehicles` and the bidding list
have no category-group switch (checked: `ui-groups` occurs only in the Stocklist browser),
so there was nothing to make consistent there.

**3. The vehicle detail header.** Now the same structure as the other heads: title, then one
actions row that wraps evenly. The customer-mode switch leads that row — it is a mode, not an
action, it has to be seen and reached first, and it keeps its wordless form in customer mode.
"Aanpassen" sat outside the head as a right-aligned block of its own and was therefore alone
on a second row on a phone; it is now the last item of the actions row and the only filled
button in it. On a phone the back link and the favourite take half a row each and "Aanpassen"
takes the full width. Every handler, route, id and wire binding is unchanged
(`client_index_mode`, `client_mode`, `on_stock_switch`, `orderBy_dropdown`, the favourite
component, the back-link logic).

## Screens touched

Stocklist, wagendetail, eigen wagenpark, wagenformulier, relaties, dealers, gebruikers,
instellingen, toegang, offertes, bestelbonnen, huurcontracten, export, lopende en gewonnen
export, biedingsaanbod, werklijsten, rollen, releasenotes, transport, opties, extra opties,
locaties, vereisten, nuttige links, merchants, documentatie.

## Screenshots

Taken at 390 and 1280 against a locally seeded database, before and after:

- `head2-{before,after}2-stocklist-{390,1280}` — Stocklist with two types (the two big pills
  that wrapped, now one segmented control)
- `head2-{before,after}5-stocklist-{390,1280}` — Stocklist with five types (now the select)
- `head2-{before,after}-detailown-{390,1280}` — the vehicle detail header of an own vehicle
  ("Aanpassen" no longer alone on a second row)
- `head2-{before,after}-relations-{390,1280}` and `head2-{before,after}-settings-{390,1280}` —
  two other heads, to show the spacing is now the same one

## Checked

- `php artisan view:cache` and `php -l` on every compiled view: clean.
- `npm run build`: clean (`public/build` untracked, not committed).
- `php artisan test --filter='SmokeTest|StylesheetSyntaxTest|UiApiUsageTest|ClassReferencesResolveTest|StocklistBrowser|OwnStockList|Vehicle|Klantmodus'`
  against a MySQL database built the way CI builds it (schema dump plus the migrations after
  2026-07-28): the same 8 failures as on `origin/main` with the same run (OwnVehicleAuthorization,
  OwnStockList average price, VehicleSheetEmptyAmount) and nothing new. Those are local
  environment failures, unrelated to page heads.
- Measured the gap from the top bar to the title on twelve screens at both widths: one value,
  20px, before and after in the table above.
- Grepped `resources/js/**` and the views for the ids and classes touched
  (`client_index_mode`, `client_mode`, `on_stock_switch`, `orderBy_dropdown`, `ui-groups`,
  `ui-detail-header*`) before moving them; the layout script that decorates `.ui-groups` as a
  scroll row still finds it.
- Clicked the new select through Livewire: choosing another type re-renders the results for
  that type.
params.title: One page head everywhere, and headers that fit a phone
